purpose: Teach: 実戦/石綿/快晴/歳児/ミドル/水上/境内/パース

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、武術家の実戦的襲撃を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police handle actual martial arts attacks like this one, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant phrasing. Seeking confirmation rather than asserting. Measured pace, almost questioning his own understanding even as he speaks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、石綿関連の労災事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police also handle asbestos-related workplace injury cases, correct?
lines.style: Calm, professional affirmation. Speaking from institutional knowledge. Even tempo, reassuring without condescension. Brief pause before speaking, like recalling procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、快晴の日の交通事故統計を、警察、把握されますね
lines.en: The police keep statistics on traffic accidents on clear days like this, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, slightly tentative. Building on what he's learned. Softer attack, genuinely wondering if he's piecing this together correctly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、三歳児への声かけ事案を厳しく追われますね
lines.en: The police pursue cases of adults approaching young children quite seriously, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly firmer. Professional certainty underlying the question. Steady eye contact level in the voice. The weight of something he takes seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ミドルマネージャー層の不正を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police investigate corruption involving middle management, cases like that?
lines.style: Contemplative, slightly probing. Testing his understanding of police jurisdiction. Gentle cadence, genuine uncertainty underneath the phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、水上警察も担当されますね
lines.en: The police oversee river and coastal patrols too, I understand?
lines.style: Building confidence slightly. Still deferential but less tentative than earlier. Looking for confirmation of expanding scope. Steady, almost academic interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、神社境内での盗難を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police investigate theft incidents on shrine grounds, don't they?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, almost academic in tone. Returning to the reflective pattern. Patient, like he's methodically working through a list. Soft conclusion.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、文章のパース解析で証拠分析もされますね
lines.en: The police also analyze textual evidence, parsing written documents for investigation, correct?
lines.style: More direct this time, slightly sharper focus. Professional inquiry into forensic methodology. Firmer attack on the opening phrase, genuine curiosity about technical capabilities.
